scope: Four bread squares follow a one-third batch of Hot Bread Kitchen’s weighed dough and lamination method, with separate measured dusting semolina and serving honey. The 30- and 15-minute rests are included in the 90-minute estimate. All oil and butter are counted. No physical preparation trial was performed.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Source 110 (all-purpose wheat flour). The edible input is weighed directly.
ingredients.edibleEvidence: All quantities refer to the weighed edible ingredient.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: All edible input nutrients counted. Water evaporation and minor cooking losses are not measured.
